name: Sun Cleric Bless: self and one ally, previous ally loses it (#7719)
contract: #7719: Bless' own text is "Bless yourself and an ally, restoring 5 % of their maximum health ... Can only
affect 1 ally at a time", so the intended behaviour is: blessing an ally blesses the caster too, blessing a
second ally moves the ally half of it and the first ally loses it, and the caster keeps theirs. The aura
script applies the self half by casting Bless on the caster and tracks the single ally it blessed. This
scenario follows that text: bless the first ally (both hold it), then the second (the second ally holds it,
the first one does not, the caster still does). The self-cast path itself is not asserted: the harness's
self-target does not land the aura, although the same cast does in game.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle
the caster holds it too: bless yourself and an ally
Wait out Bless' own 15 s cooldown
REALITY: the first ally loses it
and the caster still holds theirs
